Beginning in September 2011, {{pmin|France|French}} publisher Kurokawa began publishing chapters of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of [[Pokémon Adventures]] as a series titled "{{tt|Pokémon Noir et Blanc|Pokémon Black and White}}". As the chapters in the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} had not yet been published in volume format in Japan, these volumes are collected directly from the magazine version. This series differs from [[VIZ Media]]'s [[List of Pokémon Black and White volumes|Pokémon Black and White]] volumes — these are a more typical length of seven or eight chapters each while VIZ Media's volumes are only three or four chapters.
